Three liquids P, Q and R have different densities and do not mix. The liquids are placed in a
measuring cylinder and allowed to settle. A small block is then dropped into the measuring
cylinder and comes to rest, as shown.

block
P
Which statement about the density of the block is correct?
A
It is equal to the density of Q.
B
It is greater than the density of P.
C
It is greater than the density of R.
D
It is less than the density of Q.

options.label: A
options.text: It is equal to the density of Q.

options.label: B
options.text: It is greater than the density of P.

options.label: C
options.text: It is greater than the density of R.

options.label: D
options.text: It is less than the density of Q.
